question: Which country took over the presidency of the G7 in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Canada assumed the presidency of the G7 in January 2025, taking over from the prior presidency country.
 
• The G7 (Group of Seven) is an intergovernmental organization consisting of the world's largest advanced economies, including the US, UK, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, and Japan.
 
• The presidency of the G7 rotates annually among its member countries, giving each the responsibility of hosting the annual summit and setting the agenda for global discussions.
 
• As the president, Canada is expected to focus on key issues such as climate change, global economic stability, and international security.
 
• The 2025 G7 Summit, under Canada's leadership, will bring together heads of state and government to discuss and coordinate policies on pressing global challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **G7 Overview:**

 
 
• The G7 was established in 1975 as a forum for the world's leading industrialized nations to discuss and coordinate economic policies.
 
• The group addresses global issues such as trade, climate change, development, and security.
 
• Unlike the G20, the G7 does not include emerging economies like China, India, or Brazil.
 
 
 
• **Canada's Role in the G7:**
 
 
• Canada joined the G7 in 1976, one year after its formation, and has hosted the summit several times, most recently in 2018.
 
• The country is known for championing issues like environmental sustainability, gender equality, and global health during its presidencies.
 
 
 
• **Structure of the G7 Presidency:**
 
 
• The presidency is responsible for organizing the annual summit, ministerial meetings, and setting the group’s agenda for the year.
 
• The host country works closely with other member states to ensure consensus on key issues.
 
 
 
• **2025 G7 Agenda:**
 
 
• Although the official agenda is yet to be finalized, Canada is expected to prioritize climate action, energy transition, and global economic recovery.
 
• Other topics may include strengthening global health systems and addressing food security.
